name: dr-sri-sushma-clinic-app
description: Clinic management app for Dr.Sri Sushma Multispeciality Dental Clinic: scheduling, EMR/dental charting, billing, WhatsApp reminders. Offline-capable PWA on Cloudflare Workers/Pages/D1/R2.

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/api && npm run lint -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/api && npm run test -w apps/web
